article.headline: Martin's 20 lead Mercyhurst over Binghamton 82-61
article.description: — Qadir Martin scored 20 points as Mercyhurst beat Binghamton 82-61 on Saturday.
article.story: ERIE, Pa. -- — Qadir Martin scored 20 points as Mercyhurst beat Binghamton 82-61 on Saturday. Martin added 10 rebounds and three blocks for the Lakers (5-8). Kaden Fuhrmann shot 6 for 9, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc to add 17 points. Mykolas Ivanauskas finished 6 of 10 from the field to finish with 13 points. Jeremiah Quigley led the way for the Bearcats (3-10) with 24 points and four assists. Binghamton also got 17 points and nine rebounds from Wes Peterson, and Bryson Wilson had six points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
